question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**an uptrend**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage mentions that tea prices rose dramatically last year.
 
• It is looking for a term that indicates the prices generally showed a positive trend before stabilizing at a high level.
 
• "**An uptrend**" fits well because it indicates a general rise in prices, which aligns with the dramatic rise mentioned for the previous year.
 
• Other options like "an inflow", "an innate", and "a reduction" do not fit the context. "An inflow" suggests the arrival of a large quantity, "an innate" is not relevant here, and "a reduction" implies a decrease, which is not aligned with the rise in prices.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Tea prices in the domestic **market__** continue to rule high in the current year despite the expectation of a higher production as compared to the previous year. During the past three months, tea prices have been **__aligning__** with the prices of other companies. Unlike last year, tea prices have generally shown **__an uptrend__**, when tea prices rose dramatically, this year, prices seem to have **__stabilized__** at a rather high level. In the subsequent four months, the **__overall__** average price showed a downtrend.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• An inflow (प्रवाह): "An inflow" refers to the arrival or introduction of a large amount, which does not fit the context of price trends.
 
• An innate (अंतरनिहित): "Innate" means inborn or natural; unrelated to the context of price trends.
 
• A reduction (कमी): "A reduction" indicates a decrease, which does not fit the context of prices rising.
